SELECT
  si.batch_id,
  sh.customer_id,
  c.company_name,
  c.customer_code,
  si.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  si.quantity_shipped,
  oli.unit_price,
  (si.quantity_shipped * oli.unit_price) AS shipment_item_value
FROM shipment_items si
JOIN shipments sh ON si.shipment_id = sh.shipment_id
JOIN customers c ON sh.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_line_items oli ON si.line_item_id = oli.line_item_id

WHERE si.batch_id IN ('RUN-20261022-90001', 'RUN-20261021-92001', 'RUN-20261021-92004', 'RUN-20261022-91002', 'RUN-20261022-91005')
ORDER BY si.batch_id, c.customer_id, si.product_id
